text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I bumped into Dr. Reiz picking up 
scattered documents in the hallway.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Carrying all this by myself 
was reckless after all.
choice_data_list: I'll help! Where are we carrying this?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
! Perfect timing, Trainer. I was just 
heading over to you two.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"This is the research data from <chrname> and the 
others. I thought I'd give back to 
everyone the information we gathered 
through our repeated training runs."
choice_data_list: All the more reason to let me help.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yeah. That helps a lot. Now then, 
who should we hand them out to first...
choice_data_list: Biwa Hayahide
Narita Taishin
Air Shakur
Symboli Kris S
Tanino Gimlet
Dr. Lights

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you. I had gathered data in 
my own way, but now I have access to much 
more detailed statistics. I will use this 
as reference.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I see. If I was able to help, then I'm 
glad... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
... Doctor, could you please look this way 
for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Your eyes are a bit bloodshot after all. 
You pushed yourself too hard putting this 
together, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ah, no. That's not the case at all. 
...Though I did go to bed just a tiny bit 
later than usual.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There are dairy and banana sweets. Let's 
give them those.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"The tryptophan contained in them serves 
as the raw material for components that 
improve sleep quality."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Are you eating three meals a day? You must 
not neglect your diet just because you're 
busy. You need to consciously make time to 
eat—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah. Understood... You're right. I'll 
be careful.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
…………Ah. I'm sorry. I just tend to worry 
too much...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Ah, no, no. There is no need to 
beat yourself up, Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
That is one of your good qualities, after 
all—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"...This is bad. Looks like rain. I'd 
rather not let the wheelchair get wet, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —I see you're still here after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You didn't seem satisfied with the 
measurements earlier, so I thought, just 
maybe...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll hold the umbrella. Now then, let us 
verify the data to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
It really made me realize once more. It's 
precisely because of your thoughtfulness 
that we've made it this far.
choice_data_list:
That's not a weakness, it's one of your 
strengths

That's not a weakness—it's one of your 
strengths

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Looking at it from a different 
perspective, that's true. Heh... you've 
opened my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then, for your own sake... Could you 
please take a proper rest?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Guh... True, sleep is indeed important. I 
should reflect on my own actions as 
well...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Just a little more... 
just a little bit more...
choice_data_list: Taishin! Dr. Lights gave us the report!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ... Just leave it there.
choice_data_list: Ah, Taishin!?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. I see you are devoted to your 
training. In that case, I shall take my 
leave."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Gulp... gulp...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... the doctors came 
by. ...Something about a report?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
This is... this much data. ...In just a 
few days...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while discussing future plans 
with Dr. Reiz—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: ...Eh? What's up with that bento?
...Eh? What's with that boxed lunch?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Startled, I exchange glances with Dr. 
Wright. As I try to make sense of what on 
earth is going on—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I just made too many sandwiches, that's 
all. If you don't want any, I'll take them 
home.
choice_data_list: No, no, no! I'll gratefully accept it!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly...! How long has it been since I 
last had such a civilized meal?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Cultured...? All I did was cut it and 
sandwich it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Wash the container before you give it 
back, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Just put it down over there.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, what are you doing with 
that? It looks like blueprints for a 3D 
model, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't go snooping around. ...It's 
just a hobby, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A fully autonomous pacing robot. It's a 
flash of inspiration, but the concept 
itself was already there.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I didn't think it was worth the return, so 
I kept it on ice for a long time, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Well. If it's just something I can whip 
up in my spare time, sure.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I see. Shakur, have you finally 
awakened to the joy of building robots?!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Alright, if that's the case— As a pioneer, 
allow me to offer some advice!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Not like I asked ya to tell me, though.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"That covers most of my advice regarding 
3D modeling. As for the OS..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—"I'll let Parcae ride. She's my partner 
who knows everything about me. She's 
perfect for the job."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...With this, it's one step closer to 
completion.
choice_data_list: I hope it goes well!
I hope it goes well, huh!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Aah? What's that supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She claimed it was just a casual hobby on 
the side, but... watching Air Shakur's 
dedication made it immediately clear that 
wasn't the case.
choice_data_list:
She seems really serious about building 
that robot!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk. Knock that crap off.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Still... Dr. Wrights went and proved it 
ain't impossible."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm just doing it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though her words sounded listless, there 
was an unmistakable fire burning in her 
eyes."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Report――appreciated. With this, 
training――more, efficient――"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"You've done so much for me, after all. Or 
rather, you're still taking care of me 
even now, but..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we? Today as well.
choice_data_list: Huh... What is it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
1... 2... 3... 4... Pace, 
disrupted――gradually.
choice_data_list:
(It was muscle training! And she's taking 
it super seriously!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Keep—mind the tempo. Don't rush, lower 
it—slowly..."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Ngggh...!! L-Like this...?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――No. More. With how you are now――you can 
do even more――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ......No. It's... nothing.
choice_data_list: ...? What's up so suddenly?

...? What's brought this on all of a 
sudden?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Coaching. ——With my way of doing 
things—— I often end up——scaring people."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
My juniors... always cower before me. 
That's why— —I was being careful, and 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry...
choice_data_list: I see, so that's...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: ... Kris S, watch me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having said that, Dr. Leitz brought out 
several roof tiles from somewhere and—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Phew...... Hah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Craaaash!)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
This is the proof. Proof of how 
upright—and how exceptional of a leader 
you truly are.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"So please. Don't hold back on my 
account... Will you continue providing the 
'guidance' you see fit?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Professor... I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Then... let's continue. —Next up, 
crunches.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Symboli Kris S said that, it almost 
seemed as though... she was smiling.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! So the tome recording all of my 
hoofprints is finally complete!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My thanks, Princess of Wheels. With this, 
I shall hasten all the faster toward the 
garden of the twilight maidens.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
――Now then, time to inspect the great 
casks in the cellar. As thanks for this 
occasion, what I should offer you is――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—"Dum spiro, spero." It's a non-alcoholic 
twist on a Golden Dream.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! It's quite sweet. Yet, it's not 
overly rich...
choice_data_list: Yeah! It's smooth and delicious!
Yeah! It's so easy to drink and delicious!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, seriously... you whipped this up in 
no time at all?! That's incredible!?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No. I took my time with the aging. —Twice. 
Twice I have watched the moon wane—and wax 
full again.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"...So you've been doing this for about 
two months? Why would you do such a 
thing—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh... You don't understand?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That day, when the beast of reason and 
intellect unraveled ST-2— it convinced me 
that I could even reach the sun.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You have continually displayed your 
aesthetics— and arrived here! You have 
claimed the winged sandals!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why—aesthetics must be 
met with aesthetics. I merely responded in 
my own way.
choice_data_list: Gimlet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her heartfelt feelings strikes a 
chord within me as well. It was a 
celebratory drink truly befitting of her.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. I never expected such a 
wonderful gift... How could I ever repay 
you?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. It is too early to applaud the 
final curtain. I will collect my payment 
in due time――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
On the day of reckoning that will 
eventually come. —At Tokyo Racecourse!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just carrying luggage felt insufficient 
to repay the devoted Dr. Reiz for her 
kindness. And so—"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. Thanks to you, I was 
able to give them out to everyone.
choice_data_list:
No, I'm the one who should be thanking 
you.

No, I'm the one who should be thanking 
you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I checked the report for <chrname> as well... and 
the contents were very informative. So, to 
repay the favor, even if just a little—
choice_data_list:
...Could I have just a moment of your 
time?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: ...What is this?
choice_data_list:
This is the ST-2 report I put together 
myself.

This is the ST-2 report I put together in 
my own way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it's just a makeshift compilation 
of the notes I took during training. It 
can't even begin to compare to her report, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
......No, it's fine. Yeah... it's fine. 
Very much so.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
It's not through the eyes of a researcher. 
It's as if ST-2 is treated like an 
individual Umamusume... That kind of 
perspective exists here—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: You really were my Trainer, weren't you?
